visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair, wearing a light gray shirt, holds a black modular power bank close to the camera in a bright indoor studio. He smiles enthusiastically while demonstrating the magnetic separation of the device's components. (2) Close-up shot showing a white power strip on a desk; a small black component of the power bank is plugged into it, and hands detach the main body. (3) The man holds the device again, gesturing towards four different colored units (white, beige, gold, black) placed on a surface in front of him. (4) Extreme close-up of two built-in charging cables (Lightning and USB-C) being pulled out from the side of the black device. (5) Detailed macro shots highlight the wireless charging surfaces on the device, including a specific circular icon for the Apple Watch, with high-contrast studio lighting reflecting off the metallic surface. (6) A top-down shot shows the power bank charging an iPhone and an Apple Watch simultaneously on a dark surface. (7) Close-up of the detachable base component revealing a USB-C charging port. (8) The base component is shown plugged into a wall outlet, acting as a standalone charging brick for a smartphone. (9) Handheld demonstration of attaching international plug adapters (UK and EU styles) to the detachable base. (10) A modular lanyard, which is also a USB-C cable featuring a small ghost logo, is dangled in front of a blurred background. (11) Back to the man in the studio, he demonstrates a spinning 'fidget toy' feature of the device, holding it and spinning the top part rapidly. (12) The man points toward the screen as yellow text overlays appear with pricing and a call to action.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian male with short black hair styled with a side part, wearing a light gray collared button-down shirt and a lapel microphone.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, minimalist studio background with white walls and soft, warm ambient lighting. Some shots feature a desk surface where products are placed, showing a power strip and other tech accessories.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins immediately with a clear, professional studio tone over upbeat, driving electronic background music with a strong synth beat. (2) A sharp mechanical 'click' sound effect triggers as the user describes the magnetic separation of the power bank. (3) The narration continues at a fast, enthusiastic pace detailing the device's multi-charging capabilities; a subtle 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a visual cut to the built-in cables. (4) Distinct metallic clicking and snapping sounds are heard as the UK/EU adapters are mentioned and demonstrated. (5) A resonant 'pop' sound effect occurs when highlighting the modular lanyard cable. (6) The audio enters a rhythmic phase with rapid clicking and spinning sounds as the 'stress relief' fidget feature is demonstrated, syncing with the speaker's playful tone. (7) Final pricing details are delivered with high vocal arousal and persuasive intonation, ending with a call to action while the BGM reaches a peak and then cuts out abruptly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Inventory -> Practical Benefits -> Bonus Feature -> Pricing/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'FA DIAN' modular power bank by demonstrating its versatile, all-in-one design (detachable base, built-in cables, wireless charging, travel adapters) and its unique fidget toy function, ultimately driving sales via a group-buy discount code.
